Questions

Good to know.

Do you deliver meal plans in Dubai Festival City?

Yes. We deliver every morning to homes and offices across Dubai Festival City (DFC), including Al Badia. All of the day's meals arrive together in one chilled bag.

Do you deliver to Al Badia Residences and Al Badia Hillside Village?

Yes. Message us on WhatsApp with your building and we will confirm the drop-off point.

Can I get lunch delivered to my office in DFC?

Yes. Your meals arrive every morning, so lunch is sorted before the workday starts. Teams can also share one monthly plan with one delivery for everyone.

How much is a meal plan in Dubai Festival City?

Weekly plans cost AED 215, 415 or 610 for 1, 2 or 3 meals a day. Monthly plans cost AED 715, 1,400 or 1,999, which is AED 25.63 to 30.71 per meal.
